covered_report_window.description: U.S.-listed companies reporting after Tuesday, September 29, 2026 market close through before Wednesday, September 30, 2026 market open

market_context_summary: U.S. equities were modestly lower as rising Treasury yields and an oil price near $97 per barrel pressured risk appetite amid the continuing Iran conflict. This is an unfavorable backdrop for long-duration and high-expectation equities.

excluded_candidates.reason: Results were released September 28 and the call was moved to September 29 before the open; no longer an actionable post-close event.
Official IR date is October 6, outside the window.
Third-party calendar listing lacked confirmation on the company's IR calendar.

independent_pass_method.disparity_definition: 0-100 composite of normalized spread in direction scores and reversal-risk estimates across Pass A, B and C; lower is tighter agreement.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY2027 AI-revenue growth and core operating-margin outlook
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: A strong Q4 is priced in; FY2027 guide may miss whispers
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI infrastructure demand and improving portfolio breadth favor upside, but the stock needs a credible FY2027 beat-and-raise style outlook to clear a demanding bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is approximately $9.7-$9.8 billion revenue and $4.07-$4.10 core EPS versus company Q4 guidance of $9.2-$10.0 billion and $3.80-$4.20.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY2027 AI revenue accelerates near or above prior indications and core operating margin exceeds 6% with strong free cash flow.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: AI capacity spending, customer concentration, or margin guidance disappoints after a substantial re-rating.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly a 9% move, near the stock's long-run average; bullish analyst positioning raises the beat threshold.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Most recent major ratings remain constructive, though Goldman Sachs cut its target to $375 while UBS upgraded to Buy and other firms raised targets.

key_sources.title: Jabil Q3 FY2026 results and outlook

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-09-30 before market open; Q&A at 09:30 ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic sales/volume and adjusted gross margin
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak volume, continuing inflation and a reduced fiscal 2027 outlook favor downside, but the reset valuation and modest expectations leave meaningful relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is approximately $2.59 billion revenue and $0.31 adjusted EPS, both lower year over year.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Pricing, productivity and resilient frozen/snacks demand produce less-bad organic sales and stabilize gross margin.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Elasticity and cost inflation pressure volume and adjusted gross margin, reinforcing the weak fiscal 2027 guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about a 5.1% move; the compressed stock and modest bar make an upside reversal plausible.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent estimates have moved lower and the rating stance is cautious; the company entered the quarter guiding FY2027 organic sales down 1%-3% and adjusted EPS of $1.40-$1.50.

key_sources.title: Conagra Q4 FY2026 results and FY2027 guidance

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Constant-currency growth and FY2026 guidance retention
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Depressed valuation and low expectations enable relief rally
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Near-zero organic growth, margin compression and AI-disruption fears make another guidance disappointment more likely than a clean re-rating, but the stock is heavily de-risked.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $2.48 billion revenue and $2.81 adjusted EPS, while company Q3 guidance was $2.465-$2.490 billion and $2.65-$2.77.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: iX bookings convert to revenue, free cash flow remains strong, and management stabilizes full-year growth and margin guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Constant-currency growth stays near zero, margins remain under pressure, or full-year guidance is cut again.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about a 13% move; the stock trades near reduced analyst targets after a severe reset, making relief risk high.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Bank of America, Barrington and Baird all cut targets after Q2; recent consensus evidence is mixed and not improving materially.

key_sources.title: Concentrix Q2 FY2026 results and guidance
Concentrix preview and analyst target changes

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic ASV growth and initial FY2027 outlook
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Margin pressure or conservative FY2027 guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Accelerating ASV growth, >95% retention and broader AI adoption support upside if FY2027 guidance validates durability, though margin erosion caps conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $629.8 million revenue and $4.35 adjusted EPS; the market is focused more on organic ASV and FY2027 guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic ASV holds near 7%, retention stays above 95%, and fiscal 2027 guidance shows durable growth with margin stabilization.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Technology and compensation spending keep margins falling or the FY2027 guide implies slower ASV growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 10.4%, well above the 10-year average move of about 6.7%, signaling elevated uncertainty.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: September brought several target raises and a William Blair upgrade, but the overall rating mix remains Hold/Reduce.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Conventional egg selling price versus segment margins
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar, net cash, and prepared-foods resilience
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Trough wholesale egg pricing likely keeps conventional-shell economics weak, while specialty and prepared foods may not yet fully offset the pressure.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus calls for roughly $579-$587 million revenue and a loss near $0.68-$0.72 per share after a $0.76 Q4 loss.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Egg pricing is less bad than feared, prepared-food margins improve, and the company emphasizes balance-sheet-supported buybacks or recovery signs.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Oversupply sustains loss-making conventional-shell economics and the cumulative loss delays variable dividends.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Published implied-move estimates range around 7%-10%; low expectations and a stock below the recent $75 target make relief risk substantial.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage is thin; BMO cut its target from $83 to $75 while retaining Market Perform.

research_allocation_view.rationale: No name simultaneously cleared absolute direction score above 30, consensus reversal risk of 40 or below, and sufficient confidence. JBL, CAG, CNXC and FDS exceeded the score threshold but failed the reversal-risk threshold; CALM did not exceed the score threshold and also had high reversal risk.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All passes favored upside on AI demand and operational momentum; all independently flagged a demanding FY2027 bar.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Q4 near the upper half of guidance and constructive FY2027 AI/margin outlook.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: FY2027 AI growth and margin outlook exceed expectations.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Capex, customer concentration or margin guide disappoints.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All passes favored downside on volume, inflation and margin pressure; all applied a low-bar relief-risk penalty because the stock and outlook have already reset.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Organic sales decline and margins remain under pressure, broadly validating the FY2027 guide.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Productivity, price/mix and category share gains stabilize the margin faster than expected.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Volume elasticity and inflation drive another guidance de-risking.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All passes favored downside on weak growth and margin trends; all highlighted a severe reset and relief-rally risk.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Results near guidance but no convincing growth inflection.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: AI-enabled bookings and FCF stabilize the guide.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Another guidance cut or margin miss.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All passes favored modest upside on ASV and retention; margins and a potentially conservative FY2027 guide limited conviction.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: ASV remains healthy and guidance is broadly constructive.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Slower ASV and more spending pressure.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All passes favored downside on conventional egg economics; all assigned high relief risk because expectations are already depressed.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Another loss quarter with incremental diversification progress.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Egg pricing troughs and prepared-food margins surprise.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_reason: Score magnitude below 31 and reversal risk above 40.

lessons_review.note: Existing calibration was applied; no new method change was warranted.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
